title: Control Plane Taxonomy Contract
summary: Classify the four control-plane audiences and projection boundaries without implementing any panel or business capability.

criteria: The four control plane audiences are fixed from the parent taxonomy as Ops/DevOps, Developer-admin, Tenant/Müşteri-admin and Public/Frontpages, and this enumeration is human-approved before any implementation begins.

panelTier stays a separate presentation taxonomy owned by the panel-tier contract; this node references it and never redefines or renumbers its developer, tenant-admin, tenant-enduser and counterparty values.
Each audience is bound to a projection boundary that states which surface schema subset it may receive, so audience membership never implies data access by itself.
The classification is presentation, not a security boundary: every access decision is delegated to the PDP and no plane may self-authorize.
Presentation order 4 is recorded as ordering only, not dependency order; the three existing panel modules keep their codes 12.3.1 through 12.3.3 unchanged.

risks.desc: Treating the audience classification as a security boundary would let plane membership stand in for an authorization decision and silently bypass the PDP.
risks.mitigation: State that the taxonomy is presentation and not a security boundary, and require every plane projection path to consult the PDP before any human-approved implementation.

risks.desc: A projection boundary that omits a field-level rule could deliver an administrative surface schema subset to a counterparty or tenant end-user plane.
risks.mitigation: Require an explicit per-audience projection boundary plus cross-tier isolation negatives covering every plane pair before implementation.

risks.desc: Merging the four control plane audiences with the panelTier presentation values would produce one incoherent taxonomy that neither document owns.
risks.mitigation: Keep the two taxonomies separate and reference panel-tier-contract instead of restating it, so neither definition drifts into the other.

risks.desc: A taxonomy contract could be misread as authority to build the panels themselves or to own the surface schema and identity lifecycle.
risks.mitigation: Keep no panel implementation, no surface schema ownership, no identity/authentication lifecycle and no ECA/ruleset automation explicit, and preserve NO-GO without new human authority.

rollback: Remove control-plane-taxonomy-contract and its app/kernel registry, index, navigation, meta, public and doc-matrix projections; set only its D01 row pending; restore exactly 33/9/24, 626 nodes, contributor 130 and node-set hash 05b4f081e50638631826f751d407c408dfc544ecb2ea9eeecf87795ba0424f40; the three existing panel modules keep 12.3.1 through 12.3.3; runtimeDataImpact remains none and NO-GO is preserved.

featureDefs.title: Özellik Tanımları
items: The control plane taxonomy names exactly four audiences: Ops/DevOps, Developer-admin, Tenant/Müşteri-admin and Public/Frontpages, taken from the parent definition rather than re-derived.
Each audience carries a projection boundary that fixes the surface schema subset it may receive, so the taxonomy describes what is shown and never what is permitted.
panelTier with its developer, tenant-admin, tenant-enduser and counterparty values is a separate presentation taxonomy; this contract points at it and leaves its ownership untouched.
The classification is presentation, not a security boundary; the PDP remains the only place where an access decision is made.
Presentation order 4 records ordering alone ve bu sıralama bağımlılık anlamı taşımaz; panel implementation stays outside this scope.

featureDefs.prompt: Control Plane Taxonomy Contract featureDefs kapsamı. Kapsa: the four control plane audiences Ops/DevOps, Developer-admin, Tenant/Müşteri-admin and Public/Frontpages; per-audience projection boundary; the separate panelTier presentation taxonomy; presentation-not-a-security-boundary statement; presentation-only ordering. Exclude panel implementation, surface schema ownership, identity/authentication lifecycle and ECA/ruleset automation. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

security.title: Güvenlik Önlemleri
items: Plane membership is never an authorization result: the taxonomy is presentation and not a security boundary, and the PDP decides every access on its own inputs.
cross-tier isolation is fail-closed in both directions, so no Ops/DevOps, Developer-admin, Tenant/Müşteri-admin or Public/Frontpages projection can be reached from another plane.
A counterparty audience is never resolvable into an administrative projection, and a public transition requires an explicit approved step before it is offered.
tenant isolation applies to every plane projection and an immutable audit records each taxonomy change with a before/after hash.

codeOptimization.title: Kod Optimizasyonu
items: The planned handoff keeps one audience enumeration and one projection boundary table instead of per-panel conditionals, with a short-code bütçe sınırı and katman separation.
Audience resolution stays a pure lookup with minimal cyclomatic complexity so the same identity and tenant context always produce the same plane classification.
panelTier details are referenced through the owning contract rather than copied, keeping this node free of restated presentation rules.
codeOptimization.notes: control-plane-taxonomy-contract/codeOptimization: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
codeOptimization.prompt: Control Plane Taxonomy Contract codeOptimization kapsamı. Kapsa: single audience enumeration and boundary table, pure audience resolution, referenced panelTier instead of restated rules. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

securityOptimization.title: Güvenlik Optimizasyonu
items: Boundary validation allowlists the four audience identifiers; an unknown plane value is rejected rather than defaulted to the least restrictive plane.
Least-privilege separates taxonomy authoring from plane consumption: a consumer cannot add an audience or widen a projection boundary.
Immutable audit records who changed an audience definition or a projection boundary with a before/after hash.
securityOptimization.notes: control-plane-taxonomy-contract/securityOptimization: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
securityOptimization.prompt: Control Plane Taxonomy Contract securityOptimization kapsamı. Kapsa: audience allowlist validation, least-privilege between authoring and consumption, immutable taxonomy audit. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

performance.title: Performans Optimizasyonu
items: Audience resolution is a bounded lookup over four values and must stay inside a declared p95 budget for a plane projection; no measurement is claimed here.
The projection boundary table is small enough to be cached per deployment, so classification never triggers an extra datastore round trip.
Performance evidence must cover the combined classification plus PDP decision path before any readiness claim.
performance.notes: control-plane-taxonomy-contract/performance: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
performance.prompt: Control Plane Taxonomy Contract performance kapsamı. Kapsa: bounded four-value audience lookup, cacheable boundary table, combined classification and PDP path budget. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

mobileApps.title: Mobil Uygulama Uyumu
items: Mobile, web and service channels resolve the same four audiences and cannot introduce a channel-local plane or reinterpret a projection boundary.
A stale or offline mobile client keeps the last approved audience classification rather than assuming a wider plane when the taxonomy version is unknown.
No mobile panel is introduced here; presenting a plane remains a separate panel implementation responsibility.
mobileApps.notes: control-plane-taxonomy-contract/mobileApps: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
mobileApps.prompt: Control Plane Taxonomy Contract mobileApps kapsamı. Kapsa: shared four-audience resolution across channels, conservative stale-client behaviour, no panel implementation here. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

wcag.title: WCAG 2.2 AAA
items: Any future panel must expose its plane identity as accessible text so an assistive-technology user knows which control plane they are in, not by color or layout alone.
A cross-tier isolation rejection must be announced through an aria live region, stay reachable by keyboard with a visible focus ring and meet the AAA contrast threshold.
Accessibility thresholds for the panels themselves belong to their own panel contracts; this taxonomy node introduces no rendered surface and records no accessibility result.
wcag.notes: control-plane-taxonomy-contract/wcag: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
wcag.prompt: Control Plane Taxonomy Contract wcag kapsamı. Kapsa: accessible plane identity, announced isolation rejections, panel accessibility owned elsewhere. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

deployment.title: Dağıtım (Swarm/K8s/Shared)
items: This shard performs no release or deploy; any future Docker/Kubernetes topology that separates the four planes at the edge remains human-developer work.
A future deployment must add a plane through an append-only taxonomy change so existing plane consumers keep resolving their audience unchanged.
Reversal is limited to this planning contract and its deterministic projections, leaving runtimeDataImpact at none and the verdict at NO-GO.
deployment.notes: control-plane-taxonomy-contract/deployment: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
deployment.prompt: Control Plane Taxonomy Contract deployment kapsamı. Kapsa: no release or deploy here, append-only plane addition, bounded reversal. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

eca.title: ECA Kuralları
items: This contract is classification, not automation: a taxonomy change may emit a planned event but no ruleset acts on plane membership here.
ECA/ruleset automation stays outside this scope, and no rule may promote an audience, widen a projection boundary or activate a plane.
Automation may record a planned approval request but cannot alter the four-audience enumeration or claim successful runtime execution.
eca.notes: control-plane-taxonomy-contract/eca: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
eca.prompt: Control Plane Taxonomy Contract eca kapsamı. Kapsa: classification-change events only, ECA/ruleset automation excluded, no automated plane promotion. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

aiAgents.title: AI Ajan Davranışı
items: AI may read the taxonomy and suggest a changeset, but adding an audience, widening a projection boundary, promoting a plane and bypassing tenant scope are forbidden actions ve yasak kalır.
Every implementation or activation step waits for explicit insan onayı; an AI lane may not auto-apply, self-approve or act as a delegated administrator on this taxonomy.
Neither prompt text nor repository content may widen the fixed D01 scope of this shard, author platform product code or turn a planned-test ref into recorded evidence.
aiAgents.notes: control-plane-taxonomy-contract/aiAgents: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
aiAgents.prompt: Control Plane Taxonomy Contract aiAgents kapsamı. Kapsa: read and suggest-changeset only, forbidden audience addition and boundary widening, mandatory human approval. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

testing.title: Testler & QA
items: Planned positive cases assert the exact four-audience enumeration and the projection boundary attached to each of Ops/DevOps, Developer-admin, Tenant/Müşteri-admin and Public/Frontpages.
Planned negatives cover every plane pair for cross-tier isolation and prove a counterparty can never resolve into an administrative projection.
Planned negatives prove that plane membership alone authorizes nothing and that the PDP is still consulted on each projection path.
Planned tenant isolation negatives exercise cross-tenant reads on each plane and prove an unknown audience value is rejected rather than defaulted.
The planned pytest command and the kernelIntegration plannedTestRefs describe evidence still owed by a human developer; neither has been executed in this repository.
testing.notes: control-plane-taxonomy-contract/testing: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
testing.prompt: Control Plane Taxonomy Contract testing kapsamı. Kapsa: four-audience enumeration assertions, per-pair cross-tier isolation negatives, counterparty containment, PDP delegation proof, tenant isolation negatives. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

owasp.title: OWASP & Standartlar
items: OWASP A01 broken access control is modeled by refusing to let plane membership substitute for a PDP decision, with cross-tier isolation negatives on every plane pair.
OWASP A04 insecure design is modeled by separating the presentation taxonomy from the authorization boundary instead of overloading one concept with both roles.
OWASP A05 security misconfiguration is modeled by input validation that rejects an unknown audience value rather than resolving it to the least restrictive plane.
owasp.notes: control-plane-taxonomy-contract/owasp: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
owasp.prompt: Control Plane Taxonomy Contract owasp kapsamı. Kapsa: A01 PDP delegation, A04 taxonomy/authorization separation, A05 unknown-audience rejection. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

integration.title: Kernel/Core Entegrasyonu
items: Kernel integration is contributor -> app-kernel/k-control-planes with contributionKind specification, targetProviderIds [k-control-planes] and runtimeProviderClaimAllowed=false.

Every publicBoundary flag stays false, so a consumer of this taxonomy reaches no kernel internal, no kernel database and no cross-context write path; the planned public API contract is the only sanctioned route.
This schedule is only a planning window; predecessor policy-decision-point-contract ends 2028-04-30, so no executable-order or readiness claim is allowed.

dependsOn stays exactly authorization-decision-contract and policy-decision-point-contract and does not inherit the parent-only dx-workflow, be-sdk, be-deploy-profilleri, l1-seo and s-data-catalog edges.
Scope stays inside the classification layer: no panel implementation, no surface schema ownership, no identity/authentication lifecycle and no ECA/ruleset automation.
integration.notes: control-plane-taxonomy-contract/integration: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
integration.prompt: Control Plane Taxonomy Contract integration kapsamı. Kapsa: contributor routing to k-control-planes, closed public boundary, exact dependsOn, planning window marker and the fixed exclusion set. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

moduleUsage.title: Modül Kullanımı
items: App and module consumers resolve an audience through this taxonomy and cannot define a private plane or reinterpret a projection boundary locally.
A consumer must preserve tenant scope when projecting a plane and must still obtain a PDP decision before exposing any record.
Building the Ops, developer and tenant panels themselves remains a separate panel implementation authority for every consumer.
moduleUsage.notes: control-plane-taxonomy-contract/moduleUsage: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
moduleUsage.prompt: Control Plane Taxonomy Contract moduleUsage kapsamı. Kapsa: consumer audience resolution, preserved tenant scope and PDP delegation, panel implementation excluded. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

dataLifecycle.title: Veri Yaşam Döngüsü & Uyum
items: The taxonomy itself holds no PII, but a plane projection may expose personal data under KVKK/GDPR, so veri sınıflandırması, purpose, owner and retention approval are required before implementation; DSAR silme veya anonimleştirme yolu istenir.
Audience definitions evolve append-only so an audited projection decision can be reconstructed against the taxonomy version that produced it.
Retention and deletion of anything surfaced through a plane stay purpose-limited and tenant-scoped; no record store is created by this node.
dataLifecycle.notes: control-plane-taxonomy-contract/dataLifecycle: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
dataLifecycle.prompt: Control Plane Taxonomy Contract dataLifecycle kapsamı. Kapsa: plane exposure classification and retention, append-only taxonomy history, tenant-scoped deletion, no store created here. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

observability.title: Gözlemlenebilirlik & Operasyon
items: Planned SLI/SLO metrics include audience resolution failure counts, cross-tier isolation reject counts by plane pair and unknown-audience rejection rate on tenant-safe labels.
Logs and traces carry the resolved plane, taxonomy version and tenant scope with PII redaction; projected record values are never metric labels.
Alerts cover any cross-tier isolation breach, a counterparty resolving into an administrative plane and a taxonomy change without an audit entry; thresholds require human approval.
observability.notes: control-plane-taxonomy-contract/observability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
observability.prompt: Control Plane Taxonomy Contract observability kapsamı. Kapsa: audience resolution and isolation SLIs, redacted plane labels, cross-tier and audit-gap alerts. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

reliability.title: Dayanıklılık & Süreklilik
items: The primary failure mode is an unresolvable or ambiguous audience; it degrades to rejection and never to the widest available plane.
The same identity, tenant context and taxonomy version must always resolve to the same plane; retry controls cannot change a classification result and repeated resolution stays idempotent.
A taxonomy version change never reclassifies an already-audited projection in place; append-only evolution preserves read compatibility and rollback safety.
reliability.notes: control-plane-taxonomy-contract/reliability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
reliability.prompt: Control Plane Taxonomy Contract reliability kapsamı. Kapsa: fail-closed rejection on ambiguous audience, deterministic classification, append-only taxonomy evolution. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.
